diagnostic_history: Run 36654593992 proved the public candidate/blob/targets but failed because the reused old-canary harness expected #routeToggle and iframe #world.

Run 36654890708 established the actual adoption DOM contract (RUTAS JOSÉ, aria-controls=routeAdoption) and exposed two harness-only false negatives: hidden/offscreen links counted visible by Playwright and authority marker stored in HTML rather than visible body text.
Run 36655028518 used candidate-specific semantic assertions and passed both representative views.
truth_boundary: Technical candidate verification only. This does not make the adoption candidate Current, Catalog-live, Human Accepted or Served.
